subtitle: Catching a failed lookup without hiding the real problem

code:
=IFERROR(VLOOKUP(id,Table,3,FALSE),
  "Not found")

Catches #N/A, #REF!, #VALUE!, #NAME?
— all with the SAME fallback text
caption: A broken formula and an expected miss look identical afterward.

code:
=IFNA(VLOOKUP(id,Table,3,FALSE),
  "Not found")

#N/A → fallback text (expected)
Everything else → stays visible (a bug)
caption: The more honest default for a lookup, and often the right choice.
